verdict.rationale: dlt is open-source, writes to open destinations (DuckDB, SQL, Parquet/CSV/JSONL, filesystem) and data can be queried via SQL/dataframes/Ibis, with no proprietary lock-in on data format, and pipelines run anywhere Python runs, allowing users to export/leave freely. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a one-command 'full export/backup' feature and independent hands-on confirmation of a clean migration-away workflow beyond docs claims.
